input_text: To prove that Tom was in town, a witness testifies that her friend Susan told her Tom was in town.

extraction.input_text: To prove that Tom was in town, a witness testifies that her friend Susan told her Tom was in town.

claim.text: Is the statement described in this narrative hearsay under FRE 801(c)?

arguments.text: The statement was made out of court, as Susan communicated to the witness outside of the current trial proceeding.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(a) & (c): Hearsay requires a statement made by a declarant outside of the current testimony.

arguments.text: The statement contains a factual assertion, as Susan explicitly stated that Tom was in town.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(a): A statement is defined as an assertion intended to convey information.
arguments.evidence_span: Susan told her Tom was in town

arguments.text: The statement is offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted, as the witness's testimony is explicitly introduced for that purpose.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c): Hearsay is a statement offered in evidence to prove the truth of the matter asserted.
arguments.evidence_span: To prove that Tom was in town

arguments.text: No hearsay exclusion or exception applies to remove the statement from the hearsay definition.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(d)(2) & FRE 803/804: Exclusions and exceptions must be explicitly present to negate hearsay classification.
